subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Repulsive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disgusting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Repulsive"** means causing a feeling of intense disgust; something that is so unpleasant to the senses or feelings that it causes someone to feel physical sickness or strong aversion. (घृणित)

 
 
• **Example: **The sight of the spoiled food was so repulsive that it made me nauseous.
 
 

 
• **"Disgusting" **refers to something that causes revulsion or strong disapproval; it is something so offensive to the senses that it arouses a feeling of aversion. (घृणास्पद)

 
 
• **Example: **The disgusting smell coming from the garbage can made it impossible to stay in the room.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Repulsive'** is **'Disgusting'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disgusting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Attractive **(आकर्षक): Pleasing or appealing to the senses.

 
 
• **Example:** The vibrant colors of the painting make it very attractive to viewers.
 
 

 
• **Reliable **(विश्वसनीय ): Deserving trust; dependable.

 
 
• **Example: **She is known to be a reliable source of information on this topic.
 
 

 
• **Uniform** (समान): Remaining the same in all cases and at all times; unchanging in form or character.

 
 
• **Example:** The uniform design of the houses in that neighborhood gives it a cohesive look.
